introduction.en: The PLI scheme is a strategic policy initiative designed to incentivize domestic production and attract global investment.
introduction.hi: The PLI scheme is a strategic policy initiative designed to incentivize domestic production and attract global investment.

body.en: It shifts the focus from input-based subsidies to output-based performance. By rewarding incremental sales, it encourages economies of scale and technological adoption.
body.hi: It shifts the focus from input-based subsidies to output-based performance. By rewarding incremental sales, it encourages economies of scale and technological adoption.

conclusion.en: The scheme is vital for reducing import dependency and creating a robust industrial ecosystem in India.
